Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick note to summarize what we discussed, confirm the top priorities we heard, and propose a concrete path-to-deploy checklist with owners and dates so everyone is aligned. I kept this intentionally short — please correct anything I mis-captured.

Key pain & goals (from today's call)
- Latency during peak inference (recommendation: 75th percentile target < 180ms for customer-facing search flows).
- Cost pressure on high-volume embedding pipelines (batching and cache opportunities).
- Compliance: need audit logs and VPC isolation for sensitive models.
- Goal: pilot in prod-like environment for a single use case (customer support triage) by end of Q2.

Proposed path-to-deploy checklist (mutual action plan)
1) Pilot scope & success criteria — due 2028-03-22 — Owner: Priya (Stellar) + Olga (Redwood)
   - Define 2 sample flows, latency and quality targets, and KPIs for cost per 1k requests.
2) Technical review & infra sizing — due 2028-04-05 — Owner: Ben (Redwood) + Stellar infra lead (TBD)
   - Share model profile, expected concurrency, and network egress requirements.
3) Compliance & procurement (SLA / data controls) — due 2028-04-19 — Owner: Priya + Stellar procurement (Natalie)
   - Exchange SOC2 evidence, KMS options, and draft MSA redlines.
4) Pilot deployment & soak — due 2028-05-10 — Owner: Olga + Monica (CS)
   - Deploy to dedicated pool / VPC, run 2 weeks of traffic, gather performance/cost telemetry.
5) Review & decision — due 2028-05-24 — Owner: Stellar execs + Redwood AE
   - Share results and commit to next-phase capacity and contract terms.

Attachments: I attached a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (Stellar_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our short performance profile reference (redwood-performance-profiles.pdf). I also dropped the MAP to a shared Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/share/stellar/maps/SD-MAP-v1

- Priya: confirm pilot use cases and add Stellar infra contact (reply here).
- Olga: Ben & Monica will prepare an infra sizing checklist and SOC2 evidence pack by next Wednesday.
- Ben: I asked you to capture expected concurrency ranges and a preliminary cost estimate for the pilot.

If that all looks right I can kick off a calendar invite for the technical review (targeting week of 2028-03-29).
